plan: Sell SOXL, SPAL, MUU, and METU to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim CRWD to 5% and SNOW to 1% to reduce high-beta single name concentration.
Trim SPY to 20% to meet the single name concentration mandate.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation and reduces overall portfolio risk significantly.
A large cash buffer will be maintained for stability.
conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for capital preservation with a target of ~1.5% per month. It significantly de-risks the portfolio by cutting all leveraged ETFs and reducing high-beta single name exposure. Expect lower drawdowns but also more modest returns.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3%, SPAL to 2%, and MUU to 3% to reduce leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SPY to 25% to meet the single name concentration mandate.
Trim CRWD to 8% to reduce high-beta concentration.
Buy MSFT at 4% to add a high-quality tech name from the scanner's best setups.
This plan balances risk and growth, maintaining a small cash buffer.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5% per month by blending broad index, quality tech, and reduced leverage. It aims for risk-first growth, reducing concentration while still participating in market upside. Expect moderate drawdowns and returns.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to meet the single name concentration mandate.
Add to SOXL to 7% and MUU to 6% to increase leveraged semiconductor exposure.
Add to CRWD to 10% and METU to 5% to press existing strong performers.
Buy TECL at 6% to add a strong leveraged tech setup from the scanner.
This plan leans into leverage and concentration for aggressive growth.
aggressive.read: This aggressive growth plan targets ~4% per month by stretching into leverage and concentration. It raises both upside and drawdown potential significantly. Be aware that leveraged ETFs decay daily, and this mode can lose a lot fast; strict stop discipline is critical.

plan: Sell SOXL, SPAL, MUU, CRWD, SNOW, and METU to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETFs and high-beta single names.
Add to QQQI to 30% to increase exposure to income-focused ETFs.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly distributions and low drawdown.
A cash buffer will be maintained for stability.
income.read: This income plan targets ~1% per month by rotating into income/covered-call ETFs and broad index. It prioritizes low drawdown and reliable income over growth. Distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in a selloff; this is cash-like income, not a savings account.
